task: Store and read key/value pairs in a Map
returns: set() returns the Map (chainable); get() returns undefined if missing
gotcha: size is a property, not a method. Map keeps insertion order and allows any key type.

task: Delete a key from a Map
returns: true if the key existed, else false

task: Count frequencies with a Map
example: const m=new Map(); for (const c of 'aab') m.set(c,(m.get(c)??0)+1); return [...m];

task: Loop over a Map's key/value pairs
call: for (const [k, v] of m) { ... }   // m.keys(), m.values() too
returns: iterates [key, value] pairs in insertion order
example: const out=[]; for (const [k,v] of new Map([['a',1],['b',2]])) out.push(k+v); return out;

task: Track unique values in a Set
call: const s = new Set(arr); s.add(x); s.has(x); s.delete(x); s.size
returns: add() returns the Set; has()/delete() return boolean

task: Remove duplicates from an array
Get [key, value] pairs of an object
gotcha: Integer-like keys come first in ascending order, regardless of insertion.

task: Build an object from [key, value] pairs
gotcha: Works with a Map too: Object.fromEntries(map).

task: Count frequencies with a plain object
example: const o={}; for (const c of 'aab') o[c]=(o[c]||0)+1; return o;
gotcha: Keys become strings; prefer Map when keys are numbers or you need .size.

task: Max / min of an array
returns: number; Math.max() is -Infinity, Math.min() is Infinity
gotcha: Spread of ~100k+ items overflows the stack; use a loop or reduce.

task: Initialize a running min / max
call: let best = Infinity;   // or -Infinity for max
example: let best=Infinity; for (const x of [4,2,8]) best=Math.min(best,x); return best;

task: Integer division (and negatives)
gotcha: Floor and trunc differ for negatives. Math.round(-2.5) is -2 (ties go toward +∞).

task: Ceil, round, absolute value, square root, power
call: Math.ceil(x); Math.round(x); Math.abs(x); Math.sqrt(x); x ** n

task: Convert a string to a number
gotcha: parseInt is lenient (stops at the first bad char); Number is strict. Always pass the radix.

task: Convert between decimal and binary (or another base)
Shift, mask, XOR, and shift-left bit tricks
gotcha: Bitwise ops work on 32-bit signed ints: above 2^31 use BigInt. >>> 0 gives unsigned.

task: Sort numbers ascending and descending
call: arr.sort((a, b) => a - b)   // desc: b - a
returns: the SAME array, sorted in place
gotcha: The comparator returns a number, not a boolean: (a, b) => a > b misbehaves.

task: Sort pairs by the first value, then by the second
returns: the SAME array, sorted in place
gotcha: 0 is falsy, so || falls through to the next key only on ties.

task: Sort strings by length
returns: the SAME array, sorted in place

task: Swap two variables (or array slots) without a temp
gotcha: The previous line must end with a semicolon or ASI joins them.

task: Split off the first element and keep the rest
Copy an array / append without mutating
gotcha: Nested arrays are still shared. For 2D grids: grid.map((r) => [...r]).

task: Pull one field out of an object and keep the rest
Deep-copy a nested array/object
example: const a=[[1]]; const b=structuredClone(a); b[0][0]=9; return a;
gotcha: Throws on functions. JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x)) loses undefined/Map/Set.

task: Default a value only when null/undefined (not for 0)
gotcha: || also replaces 0, '' and false; ?? only replaces null and undefined.
